key_objects.name_zh: 圆盘平滑格点计数的误差估计
key_objects.name_en: mollified lattice-count estimate for the disc

key_objects.name_zh: N_δ 与 N 的夹逼关系
key_objects.name_en: sandwich relation between N_delta and N

key_objects.name_zh: Theorem 8.3 的高频尾和、夹逼与参数优化
key_objects.name_en: completion of Theorem 8.3 by high-frequency tail, sandwiching, and parameter optimization
key_objects.description: The high-frequency tail is also O(R^{1/2}δ^{-1/2}) using rapid decay of φ^. The pointwise inequalities χ_{R-δ,δ}≤χ_R≤χ_{R+δ,δ} imply (85). Combining (84)-(85) gives N(R)=πR²+O(R^{1/2}δ^{-1/2})+O(Rδ); choosing δ=R^{-1/3} yields O(R^{2/3}).

key_objects.name_zh: Theorem 8.3 的最优平滑尺度 δ=R^{-1/3}
key_objects.name_en: optimal smoothing scale delta=R^{-1/3} in Theorem 8.3
key_objects.description: Balances R^{1/2}δ^{-1/2} and Rδ, producing the exponent 2/3.

key_objects.name_zh: 强凸区域
key_objects.name_en: strongly convex domain
key_objects.description: A bounded domain Ω with C² boundary is strongly convex when the second fundamental form (19) is strictly positive definite at every boundary point.

key_objects.name_zh: 强凸区域的格点计数误差
key_objects.name_en: lattice-point error for strongly convex domains
key_objects.statement: If Ω⊂R^d is bounded, sufficiently smooth, strongly convex, and 0∈Ω, then N_R=R^d m(Ω)+O(R^{d-2d/(d+1)}) as R→∞.

key_objects.name_zh: 强凸区域平滑计数误差
key_objects.name_en: mollified counting estimate for a strongly convex domain

key_objects.name_zh: 强凸区域的平滑夹逼
key_objects.name_en: mollified sandwich for strongly convex domains

key_objects.name_zh: 强凸区域的几何膨胀包含
key_objects.name_en: geometric dilation inclusion for a convex domain
key_objects.formula: x∈RΩ and |y|≤δ imply x-y∈(R+cδ)Ω, for R≥1 and δ≤1

key_objects.name_zh: Theorem 8.4 的 Poisson 求和与参数平衡证明
key_objects.name_en: Poisson-summation and parameter-balancing proof of Theorem 8.4
key_objects.description: Use χ_R(x)=χ(x/R), smooth by φ_δ, apply Poisson summation and Corollary 3.3 to estimate χ_R^(n)=O(R^{(d-1)/2}|n|^{-(d+1)/2}). Both low and high frequencies give (86); (87)-(88) convert the smoothed count to N_R. Choosing δ=R^{-(d-1)/(d+1)} balances the two errors and yields R^{d-2d/(d+1)}.

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲测度
key_objects.name_en: Hyperbolic measure

key_objects.name_zh: 除数问题的 O(μ^{1/3} log μ) 改进
key_objects.name_en: O(mu^{1/3} log mu) improvement for the divisor problem
key_objects.statement: Σ_{k=1}^μ d(k)=μ log μ+(2γ-1)μ+O(μ^{1/3} log μ) as μ→∞.

key_objects.name_zh: 除数函数平均的改进渐近式
key_objects.name_en: improved asymptotic for the divisor summatory function
key_objects.formula: Σ_{k=1}^μ d(k)=μ log μ+(2γ-1)μ+O(μ^{1/3} log μ)

key_objects.name_zh: 除数问题对应的双曲区域
key_objects.name_en: hyperbolic region associated with the divisor problem

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲测度 h
key_objects.name_en: hyperbolic measure h
key_objects.description: A measure supported on x₁x₂=1 in the first quadrant; equivalently h(E)=∫_0^∞χ_E(u,1/u)du/u.

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲测度对双曲伸缩的不变性
key_objects.name_en: invariance of hyperbolic measure under hyperbolic dilations
key_objects.description: h is invariant under (x₁,x₂)↦(δx₁,δ^{-1}x₂), δ>0, and defines a tempered distribution on S(R²).

key_objects.name_zh: 振荡积分 J_+ 与 J_-
key_objects.name_en: oscillatory integrals J_plus and J_minus
key_objects.formula: J_±(λ)=∫_0^∞ e^{iλ(u±1/u)} du/u, interpreted by truncation

key_objects.name_zh: 截断振荡积分 J^±_{a,b}
key_objects.name_en: truncated oscillatory integrals J^±_{a,b}
key_objects.formula: J^+_{a,b}(λ)=∫_0^∞ e^{iλ(u+1/u)}η_a(u)η_b(1/u)du/u, with an analogous definition for J^-_{a,b}

key_objects.name_zh: J_+ 的存在、驻相展开与小参数对数界
key_objects.name_en: existence, stationary-phase expansion, and small-parameter logarithmic bound for J_plus
key_objects.statement: For λ≠0 the limit J^+(λ)=lim_{a,b→0}J^+_{a,b}(λ) exists. Uniformly in a,b: for |λ|≥1/2, J^+_{a,b}(λ)=(Σ_{k=0}^N c_k λ^{-1/2-k})e^{2iλ}+O(|λ|^{-3/2-N}); for |λ|≤1/2, J^+_{a,b}(λ)=O(log(1/|λ|)).

key_objects.name_zh: J_+ 相位在 u=1 的唯一驻点
key_objects.name_en: unique stationary point u=1 for the J_plus phase
key_objects.description: For Φ(u)=u+1/u, Φ′(1)=0 and Φ′′(u)>0. The substitution Φ(u)=2+x² transforms the central integral into e^{2iλ}∫e^{iλx²}α~(x)dx, so the one-dimensional stationary-phase expansion (8) applies.

key_objects.name_zh: J_+ 尾部的反复分部积分恒等式
key_objects.name_en: iterated integration-by-parts identity for the J_plus tail

key_objects.name_zh: Proposition 8.6 的驻相与非驻相证明
key_objects.name_en: stationary- and nonstationary-phase proof of Proposition 8.6
key_objects.description: Split J^+_{a,b}=I+II+III around u=1. II is handled by stationary phase after Φ=2+x². I and III have no critical point and repeated integration by parts yields rapid decay for large |λ|. For small |λ|, splitting at u=|λ| gives O(log(1/|λ|)). Cauchy estimates for I_a-I_{a′} and the analogous III term prove convergence as a,b→0.

key_objects.name_zh: J_- 的非驻相快速衰减
key_objects.name_en: rapid nonstationary decay for J_minus
key_objects.statement: The conclusions of Proposition 8.6 hold for J^- except that for |λ|≥1/2, J^-_{a,b}(λ)=O(|λ|^{-N}) for every N≥0; the phase u-1/u has no critical point because Φ′(u)=1+1/u²>1.

key_objects.name_zh: J_± 的连续性与截断参数一致性
key_objects.name_en: continuity of J_pm and uniformity in truncation parameters
key_objects.description: J^+ and J^- are continuous for λ≠0. The large/small-λ estimates remain uniform for all a,b>0, except the stationary-phase coefficients in the J^+ expansion may depend on a,b but remain uniformly bounded.

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲测度与双曲径向函数的 Fourier 变换
key_objects.name_en: Fourier transforms of hyperbolic measure and hyperbolically invariant functions

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲测度 h 的 Fourier 变换
key_objects.name_en: Fourier transform of hyperbolic measure h
key_objects.statement: For ξη≠0, h^ is continuous and equals J^+(-2π|ξη|^{1/2}) on Q1, J^-(-2π|ξη|^{1/2}) on Q2, J^+(2π|ξη|^{1/2}) on Q3, and J^-(2π|ξη|^{1/2}) on Q4.

key_objects.name_zh: Proposition 8.8 的截断测度与象限缩放证明
key_objects.name_en: truncated-measure and quadrant-scaling proof of Proposition 8.8
key_objects.description: Approximate h by finite measures h_ε. In each quadrant, scale u by (|η/ξ|)^{1/2}; h_ε^ becomes the corresponding J^±_{a,b}(±2π|ξη|^{1/2}). Proposition 8.6 and Corollary 8.7 provide pointwise convergence and integrable domination against Schwartz test functions, identifying the tempered-distribution limit with the stated continuous function away from the axes.

key_objects.name_zh: h^ 的大乘积衰减与轴附近对数增长
key_objects.name_en: decay of h^ for large product and logarithmic growth near the axes
key_objects.description: Uniformly for the approximants, |h_ε^(ξ,η)|≤A|ξη|^{-1/2} when |ξη|≥1/2 and ≤A log(1/|ξη|) when |ξη|≤1/2.

key_objects.name_zh: 第一象限中的双曲径向函数 f(x,y)=f₀(xy)
key_objects.name_en: hyperbolically invariant function f(x,y)=f0(xy) in the first quadrant
key_objects.description: f0 is C∞ with compact support in (0,∞); f(x,y)=f0(xy) on Q1 and vanishes on the other three quadrants. Such f is bounded and hence a tempered distribution, though generally not integrable on R².

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲径向函数的 Fourier 变换公式
key_objects.name_en: Fourier transform formula for hyperbolically invariant functions
key_objects.statement: For f(x,y)=f₀(xy), f^ is continuous where ξη≠0. In Q1 it is given by formula (92), with analogous quadrant formulas replacing J^+(-·) by J^-(-·), J^+(+·), and J^-(+·).

key_objects.name_zh: Q1 中双曲径向函数的 Fourier 变换
key_objects.name_en: Fourier transform of a hyperbolically invariant function in Q1

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲坐标 x=uρ, y=ρ/u 及 Jacobian
key_objects.name_en: hyperbolic coordinates x=uρ, y=ρ/u and their Jacobian

key_objects.name_zh: f_ε^ 的 J^+_{a,b} 表示
key_objects.name_en: J^+_{a,b} representation of f_epsilon^

key_objects.name_zh: Theorem 8.9 的截断与双曲坐标证明起点
key_objects.name_en: start of the truncation-and-hyperbolic-coordinate proof of Theorem 8.9
key_objects.description: Approximate f by f_ε=f₀(xy)η_ε(x)η_ε(y), change variables x=uρ, y=ρ/u, and in Q1 rescale u by (η/ξ)^{1/2} to obtain (93). The argument that f_ε^ converges to (92) continues on PDF 411.
